integrity: Exact physical-time period quadrature, asymptotic beta coefficient, and center endpoint have a complete analytical argument; the numerical check is ancillary. The present scientific review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the unit-coupling three-site phase ring at exact quadrature, reduced modulo common phase. No result about dissipative perturbations, larger rings, full phase-lift periodicity, or monotonicity of the intermediate-energy period. Prior integrability and existence of periodic islands are not new; specialized earlier priority cannot be absolutely excluded.
title: Algebraic separatrix-period law for a conservative three-oscillator phase ring
